title: Rūpam
text: 1 Sāvatthi || || 2 Taṃ kiṃ maññasi Rāhula || || Rūpā niccā vā aniccā vāti || || [page 246] 246 RĀHULA SAṂYUTTA [XVIII. 2. 3 Aniccā bhante || || 3-6 Saddā || pe|| || Gandhā || pe|| || Rasā || pe|| Poṭṭhabbā || pe || || 7 Dhammā niccā vā aniccā vāti || || Aniccā bhante || || 8 Evam passaṃ Rāhula sutavā ariyasāvako rūpesu pi nibbindati || Saddesu pi || Gandhesu pi || Rasesu pi || Phoṭṭhabbesu pi || Dhammesu pi nibbindati || || 9 Nibbindaṃ virajjati || pe|| || pajānātīti || || Dutiyaṃ || ||
